q: How much of Pune's aluminium casting output is exported, and who buys it?
title: Pune aluminium castings: exports and buyers
short: Almost 20% is exported. TERI puts Pune at about 4,00,000 t of castings a year, some 22% of India's aluminium casting output. Most units cast for vehicle makers such as Tata, Mahindra, Bajaj Auto and Honda, and for electrical firms such as Siemens and Crompton Greaves.
audience: Owners and export managers of Pune aluminium casting units answering OEM and overseas buyers

ul: Cylinder heads, engine bodies, engine pipes and suspension forks for two-wheelers and cars.
Motor bodies, pump bodies and fan parts for electrical makers.
Alloy wheels and cylinder heads from a few large, mechanised units.
Mostly from alloy ingots in LM, ADC and AC grades; only a few units melt scrap.

sections.h: Two kinds of buyer, two kinds of question
ul: Indian OEMs and their global parents ask for your product footprint as Scope 3 supplier data. It counts everything: fuel, electricity, and the alloy you buy.

EU customers may need CBAM data, but only if they declare your part under a covered aluminium code such as 7616. A casting declared as a vehicle, engine or pump part, in Chapters 84, 85 or 87, is outside CBAM today. Ask your importer which code they use before building anything.

sections.h: What to have ready before the email arrives
ol: Twelve months of furnace oil, gas, LPG, diesel and electricity, from invoices and bills.
Tonnes of good castings shipped in the same months, by product family if you can.
Alloy ingot and scrap tonnes bought, with each supplier's footprint per tonne if they have one.
The CN code each export customer declares.

p: ALUCAST, the Aluminium Casters' Association of India, has about 100 members and runs training and an annual die casting conference; MCCIA, NCTS Pune and the Pimpri Chinchwad Small Industries Association also work with the cluster.

example.title: The exported share in tonnes of CO2 (estimate)
lines: Exports: 20% x 4,00,000 t = about 80,000 t of castings a year
Cluster energy CO2: about 0.94 t per tonne of castings on today's factors
Energy CO2 riding on exports: 80,000 x 0.94 = about 75,000 t a year
The alloy itself adds more, and differs by supplier
example.note: Output and export share from TERI's profile and SAMEEEKSHA's summary (2015-16 data); CO2 per tonne from the cluster's fuel and power at CEA FY 2025-26 and IPCC 2006 factors.

senseible: For a casting under a covered code, Senseible's CBAM cost calculator shows what your figure means for the importer from 2026 to 2034, and your fuel invoices and power bills read into monthly records give the numbers behind it.
